lead: Gaganyaan is the capsule India is building to fly its own astronauts. Here you can test its escape system, its orbit and its return home.
try: Press TV-D1, 2023 to replay ISRO's real test where the escape rockets pulled the capsule away from a rocket.
points: If the rocket fails, small powerful rockets on top yank the crew capsule away in seconds.
In orbit, the capsule circles Earth about every 90 minutes, 400 km up.
Coming home, the air slows it down from very fast, then parachutes bring it gently into the sea.
